name: Damping
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 3, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You cause the energies that suffuse the target to temporarily flee them. They lose all access to spells, spell-like abilities, and use-based supernatural abilities for 1 round.
